newsitem.title: USA: US House panel votes for further cut in EEP.
newsitem.headline: US House panel votes for further cut in EEP.

text.p: The House Appropriations Committee on Wednesday voted for a further cut in funding for the main U.S. agricultural export subsidy program for fiscal 1998.
On a voice vote, the panel reduced funding for the Export Enhancement Prongram to $205 million, from $270 million approved by the Appropriations subcommittee on agriculture three weeks ago.

The Clinton administration requested $500 million for EEP in fiscal 1998. But Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman told reporters on Tuesday that the department could probably get by with just $270 million.
The full committee made the further cut on Wednesday to provide extra money for crop insurance agent commissions.
However, the funding level for EEP could still change in the coming weeks, when the fiscal 1998 agricultural spending bill goes to the House floor and then to the Senate.
